contracts.docstring: Concurrent actual Git capture plus scoped SQLite reads cannot exchange two authors' value.py; trusted closure proof is synthetic, with physical ownership covered separately.
Open an independent read connection against the caller's exact project/run, never a global last-result slot.
Return free-form native completion text without claiming an accepted product result.
Retain the chosen untrusted result body while using the real host coordinator contract.
Complete the native turn normally so the host must still keep task acceptance separate.
Even completed native transport carrying failure-like text is only a proposal; it cannot imply accepted work or trigger a new attempt.
Reopen real SQLite under a fresh host owner, reconcile an unbound historical question and deliver only the explicitly reselected corrected request; historical native identities are synthetic.

scope: New/changed Python definitions and modules in this delivery. Relevant new frontend modules and exported helpers also carry English JSDoc; no claim that all historic project definitions are documented.
